mapper.select: SELECT i.common_code_item_id, i.tenant_id, i.group_id, i.item_code, i.item_nm, i.item_dc, i.parent_item_id, p.item_nm AS parent_item_nm, i.sort_order, i.use_at, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM tb_common_code_item i LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item p ON p.common_code_item_id = i.parent_item_id WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY i.parent_item_id NULLS FIRST, i.sort_order ASC, i.common_code_item_id ASC

INSERT INTO tb_common_code_item ( tenant_id, group_id, item_code, item_nm, item_dc, parent_item_id, sort_order, use_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{groupId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemNm}, #{itemDc}, #{parentItemId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{sortOrder}, #{useAt}, NULL, NULL ) RETURNING common_code_item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_common_code_item SET item_code = #{itemCode}, item_nm = #{itemNm}, item_dc = #{itemDc}, parent_item_id = #{parentItemId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = NULL WHERE common_code_item_id = #{itemId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
